title: Silas and the Playlist
author: V. M. Zhou
blurb: Paloma Winterbourne, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, has spent seven years being so careful it hurts. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
